test.create_query: CREATE TABLE final_skip_index_scattered (key UInt64, ver UInt64, v UInt8, INDEX idx_v v TYPE minmax GRANULARITY 1) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(ver) ORDER BY key SETTINGS index_granularity = 8, index_granularity_bytes = '10Mi'
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO final_skip_index_scattered SELECT (number % 200000) * 40 + intDiv(number, 200000) AS key, 1, intHash64(key) % 20011 = 0 FROM numbers(8000000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 200000, max_insert_block_size = 200000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 0, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0

SELECT throwIf(count() != 40 OR max(min_key) >= 40 OR min(max_key) < 7999960, 'final_skip_index_exact_mode_scattered: expected 40 active parts, each covering the whole key range') FROM (SELECT _part, min(key) AS min_key, max(key) AS max_key FROM final_skip_index_scattered GROUP BY _part)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM final_skip_index_scattered FINAL WHERE v = 1 SETTINGS use_skip_indexes = 1, use_skip_indexes_if_final = 1, use_skip_indexes_if_final_exact_mode = 1, use_query_condition_cache = 0
